question: Should `step-3.7-flash` become the default for both StepFun provider surfaces in this PR, or should the model be added additively first?
rationale: Changing the shared default affects setup/auth model selection for existing StepFun surfaces, and automation cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants that provider-default change without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add the model without default promotion
options.body: Keep `step-3.5-flash` as the default, add `step-3.7-flash` with OpenClaw-supported input metadata, and revisit default promotion in a maintainer-sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Accept the default promotion
options.body: Merge the new default only after the contributor or maintainer proves fresh onboarding/default selection and at least one real StepFun request on the PR branch.

options.title: Pause for broader StepFun capability work
options.body: Wait for a separate StepFun video/capability path before advertising video input or changing defaults.

recommendation.title: Add the model without default promotion
recommendation.body: Keep `step-3.5-flash` as the default, add `step-3.7-flash` with OpenClaw-supported input metadata, and revisit default promotion in a maintainer-sponsored follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the current live assignee and has recent adjacent provider-test history, making it the best available owner for the default-model choice.
